race.comment: SATONO'S SHOUT (4) returns in a much weaker contest after holding his own in town last preparation. Kept finding in the heavy going when sixth over 1420m at Flemington last June. Strengthened over the break with the two trials and the claim helps. Leading player. I AM DYNASTY (6) three-year-old colt by I Am Invincible from the good mare Arcadia Queen on debut for the Widdup stable. Has trialled exceptionally well and gets every chance from the gate. LAST AFFAIR (8) Wootton Bassett colt from Il Affare on debut for the Michael Freedman camp. Hasn't set the track alight with his latest trials but can improve under race conditions. Each way. YES WE HAVE (10) is a son of North Pacific from High Expectations on debut for the Maher stable. Hasn't been far away in the two trials and can take a hand in the finish. The chances don't end there.
